description: Unofficial Kyojuro Rengoku fan-art companion from Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. Original friendly choreography features a bento meal, straightening the flame-edged haori, a small colorful paper pinwheel and carefully realigning a bento lid. Healthy stylized form retains yellow-red hair, dark full-length uniform, white haori and covered boots with simplified trim. Three articulated running directions and a crouch-jump are original desktop animation; no sword attack, injury or official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
